name: Test / Test All

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - rel-*
    paths:
      - '**.php'
      - '**.inc'
      - 'composer.*'
      - 'package*.json'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'docker/**'
      - 'tests/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - rel-*
    paths:
      - '**.php'
      - '**.inc'
      - 'composer.*'
      - 'package*.json'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'docker/**'
      - 'tests/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.2', '8.4']
        db-type: ['mariadb', 'mysql']
        db-version: ['11.8', '8.4']
        exclude:
          # Exclude some combinations to reduce matrix size
          - php-version: '8.2'
            db-type: 'mysql'
            db-version: '8.4'
          - php-version: '8.4'
            db-type: 'mariadb'
            db-version: '11.8'
    name: Test PHP ${{ matrix.php-version }} with ${{ matrix.db-type }} ${{ matrix.db-version }}
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup PHP"
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          extensions: bcmath, calendar, ctype, curl, dom, fileinfo, filter, gd, iconv, imagick, intl, json, ldap, libxml, mbstring, mysqli, openssl, pdo, pdo_mysql, phar, session, simplexml, soap, sockets, sodium, tokenizer, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, xsl, zip, zlib
          coverage: none

      - name: "Get composer cache directory"
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "dir=$(composer config cache-files-dir)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: "Composer Cache"
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: "Composer Install"
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: "Wait for DB"
        run: |
          timeout=60
          i=0
          until mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -u root -p"${{ secrets.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD }}" --silent; do
            if [ $i -ge $timeout ]; then
              echo "Timeout waiting for database"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Waiting for DB..."
            sleep 1
            i=$((i+1))
          done

      - name: "Run Tests"
        run: |
          # Run unit tests
          vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml --coverage-text --log-junit test-results.xml
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD }}
          DB_TYPE: ${{ matrix.db-type }}
          DB_VERSION: ${{ matrix.db-version }}
          PHP_VERSION: ${{ matrix.php-version }}

      - name: "Publish Test Results"
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: test-results.xml

  syntax:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.2', '8.4']
    name: Syntax Check PHP ${{ matrix.php-version }}
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup PHP"
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          coverage: none

      - name: "Get composer cache directory"
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "dir=$(composer config cache-files-dir)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: "Composer Cache"
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: "Composer Install"
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: "PHP Syntax Check"
        run: |
          find . -name "*.php" -not -path "./vendor/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | xargs -P 4 -I {} php -l {}

  phpstan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.2']
    name: PHPStan Analysis
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup PHP"
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          extensions: bcmath, calendar, ctype, curl, dom, fileinfo, filter, gd, iconv, imagick, intl, json, ldap, libxml, mbstring, mysqli, openssl, pdo, pdo_mysql, phar, session, simplexml, soap, sockets, sodium, tokenizer, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, xsl, zip, zlib
          coverage: none

      - name: "Get composer cache directory"
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "dir=$(composer config cache-files-dir)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: "Composer Cache"
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: "Composer Install"
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: "Run PHPStan"
        run: vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --configuration phpstan.neon.dist --level=7 src/

  rector:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.2']
    name: Rector Analysis
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup PHP"
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          extensions: bcmath, calendar, ctype, curl, dom, fileinfo, filter, gd, iconv, imagick, intl, json, ldap, libxml, mbstring, mysqli, openssl, pdo, pdo_mysql, phar, session, simplexml, soap, sockets, sodium, tokenizer, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, xsl, zip, zlib
          coverage: none

      - name: "Get composer cache directory"
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "dir=$(composer config cache-files-dir)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: "Composer Cache"
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: "Composer Install"
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: "Run Rector"
        run: vendor/bin/rector process --dry-run

    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.2']
    name: PHP Styling Check
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup PHP"
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          extensions: bcmath, calendar, ctype, curl, dom, fileinfo, filter, gd, iconv, imagick, intl, json, ldap, libxml, mbstring, mysqli, openssl, pdo, pdo_mysql, phar, session, simplexml, soap, sockets, sodium, tokenizer, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, xsl, zip, zlib
          coverage: none

      - name: "Composer Cache"
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}

            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: "Composer Install"
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: "Run PHP-CS-Fixer"
        run: vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff

  styling-js:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: ['20']
    name: JavaScript Styling Check
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup Node.js"
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: "Install Dependencies"
        run: npm ci

      - name: "Run ESLint"
        run: npm run lint:js

  styling-css:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: ['20']
    name: CSS Styling Check
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup Node.js"
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4

          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: "Install Dependencies"
        run: npm ci

      - name: "Run Stylelint"
        run: npm run stylelint

  js-unit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: ['20']
    name: JavaScript Unit Tests
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: "Install Dependencies"
        run: npm ci

      - name: "Run Jest Tests"
        run: npm run test:js

    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.2']

      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:

      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.4']
        db-type: ['mariadb']

        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          extensions: bcmath, calendar, ctype, curl, dom, fileinfo, filter, gd, iconv, imagick, intl, json, ldap, libxml, mbstring, mysqli, openssl, pdo, pdo_mysql, phar, session, simplexml, soap, sockets, sodium, tokenizer, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, xsl, zip, zlib
          coverage: pcov

      - name: "Get composer cache directory"
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "dir=$(composer config cache-files-dir)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: "Composer Cache"
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: "Composer Install"
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: "Wait for DB"
        run: |
          timeout=60
          i=0
          until mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -u root -p"${{ secrets.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD }}" --silent; do
            if [ $i -ge $timeout ]; then
              echo "Timeout waiting for database"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Waiting for DB..."
            sleep 1
            i=$((i+1))
          done

      - name: "Run Tests with Coverage"
        run: |
          vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml --coverage-clover coverage.xml
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD }}
          DB_TYPE: ${{ matrix.db-type }}
          DB_VERSION: ${{ matrix.db-version }}
          PHP_VERSION: ${{ matrix.php-version }}

      - name: "Upload Coverage to Codecov"
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          file: coverage.xml
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

        run: npm ci

      - name: "Run Jest Tests"
        run: npm run test:js

  sql-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.2']
    name: SQL Linting
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup PHP"
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          coverage: none

      - name: "Get composer cache directory"
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "dir=$(composer config cache-files-dir)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: "Composer Cache"
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: "Composer Install"
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: "Run SQL Linter"
        run: |
          find . -name "*.sql" -not -path "./vendor/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | xargs -P 4 -I {} sqrlint --config .sqruff --stdin-filename {} {}

  semgrep:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.2']
    name: Semgrep Security Scan
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup PHP"
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          coverage: none

      - name: "Run Semgrep"
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/returntocorp/semgrep/releases/download/v1.78.0/semgrep-v1.78.0-linux-amd64 -o semgrep
          chmod +x semgrep
          ./semgrep --config=auto .

  coverage:
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.4']
        db-type: ['mariadb']
        db-version: ['11.8']
    name: Combine coverage
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: "Setup PHP"
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          extensions: bcmath, calendar, ctype, curl, dom, fileinfo, filter, gd, iconv, imagick, intl, json, ldap, libxml, mbstring, mysqli, openssl, pdo, pdo_mysql, phar, session, simplexml, soap, sockets, sodium, tokenizer, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, xsl, zip, zlib
          coverage: pcov

      - name: "Get composer cache directory"
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "dir=$(composer config cache-files-dir)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: "Composer Cache"
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: "Composer Install"
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: "Wait for DB"
        run: |
          timeout=60
          i=0
          until mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -u root -p"${{ secrets.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD }}" --silent; do
            if [ $i -ge $timeout ]; then
              echo "Timeout waiting for database"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Waiting for DB..."
            sleep 1
            i=$((i+1))
          done

      - name: "Run Tests with Coverage"
        run: |
          vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml --coverage-clover coverage.xml
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD }}
          DB_TYPE: ${{ matrix.db-type }}
          DB_VERSION: ${{ matrix.db-version }}
          PHP_VERSION: ${{ matrix.php-version }}

      - name: "Upload Coverage to Codecov"
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          file: coverage.xml
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
